description: The plot illustrates how loss ratio (in percent) varies with compute measured in TFLOPs for five model variants. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” on a logarithmic scale, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 94 to 100 with integer tick marks. The purple line with triangle markers (Vanilla) is flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. The orange line with plus markers (SepLLM (n=64)) starts near 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 100.0% by 2e8, reaches a local high around 100.4% at 4e8, and ends near 99.9% at 9e8. The dark blue line with x markers (SepLLM (n=128)) begins around 97.0% at 1e7, increases to about 99.9% by 2e8, stays near 100.0% around 5e8, then slightly declines to roughly 99.8% by 9e8. The green line with diamond markers (SepLLM (n=64, H)) starts near 97.5% at 1e7, climbs to about 100.0% by 4e8, peaks around 100.2% at 6e8, and finishes near 100.0% at 9e8. The red line with circle markers (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) begins around 94.0% at 1e7, rises to about 98.0% at 1e8 and about 99.1% at 4e8, dips to roughly 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends near 98.7% at 9e8.
